OFFENSE: Special Attacks Death Cutter, Ectosmash, Flurry of Death, Lvl. 5 Death, Rend Armor
1st (DC 15) - blizzard, dark, enfeeblement, fire, ruin, thunder
2nd (DC 16) - blizzard II, dark II, fire II, poison, silence, thunder II
3rd (DC 17) - bio, blizzara, blizzard III, dark III, darkra, dispel, fira, fire III, infect, mass enfeeblement, thundara, thunder III
4th (DC 18) - blizzard IV, dark IV, disable, fire IV, poisonga, ruinra, silencega, thunder IV
5th (DC 19) - bioga, blizzaga, burn, darkga, drain, firaga, freeze, gloom, gravity, infectga, mass immobilize, poisonja, thundaga
STATISTICS: Str 14, Dex 19, Con —, Int 8, Wis 14, Cha 18
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Toughness, Weapon Focus (scythe claw)
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Once every 1d4 rounds, the gespenst can make a a single melee attack as a standard action. If it hits, the target takes the damage of the attack and must make a Fortitude save (DC 20) or be inflicted with the Doom status (as the countdown spell, not the doom spell). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th-level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 27).
A gespenst can teleport adjacent to any foe within 30 ft. and make a single attack. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 21).
Similar to a monk, a gespenst can make a flurry of blows attack at the expense of accuracy. It can make one extra attack per round as a full attack action, but each attack receives a -2 penalty.

1/day, the gespenst can call forth a great wraith who scythes at all enemies within a 30 ft. radius of the gespenst. All creatures with a total HD that is a multiple of 5 must make a Fortitude save (DC 20) or die. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th-level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 27).

If a gespenst hits with both scythe claws, it pulls apart any armor worn by its foe. This attack deals 4d4+6 points of damage to the opponent's armor. Creatures not wearing armor are unaffected by this special attack. Armor reduced to 0 hit points is destroyed. Damaged armor may be repaired with a successful Craft (armorsmithing) check.

Gespenst move aloft making them hover. This gives it movement as though it was under the effect of a float spell; this effect cannot be dispelled this also makes them immune to any movement impairments like root, immobilize, and slow.

parsed.description: Being an undead given to sudden manifestation in the streets of large towns where the living reside in numbers. Such that perish with sins unabsolved are barred from celestial reposed and cast into the darkness, from which pollution they rise once more. Though they are related in sort to the ethereal ghost, their fearsome appearance has led to the widespread belief that they are none other than the very hand of Death. This has led some necromantic authorities to place them in a genus altogether separate from their ghostly kin.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
